variables.input:
fetch dt.entity.service
| filter contains(entity.name, "alpha-engine")
| fields entity.name
| sort entity.name asc

fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.agent.name)
| summarize by: { gen_ai.agent.name }
| sort gen_ai.agent.name asc

0.content:
# Alpha Report Generator — AI Observability

**Service:** `alpha-engine`  ·  **Frontend:** `alpha-frontend`

Live view of the multi-agent report pipeline: token spend per agent + model, p95 latency, finish reasons, tool-call mix, and full report-run audit trail.

- Spans: OpenTelemetry + OpenInference → `/api/v2/otlp/v1/traces`
- Metrics: OTel GenAI histograms (`gen_ai.client.token.usage`, `gen_ai.client.operation.duration`) → `/api/v2/otlp/v1/metrics` (DELTA)
- Lifecycle events: `tasks.ps1` / `tasks.sh` → Events API v2

See `docs/instrumentation.md` for the wiring.

1.title: Reports generated
1.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter span.name == "invoke_agent alpha_orchestrator"
| summarize reports = count()

2.title: Total tokens
2.query:
timeseries total = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage), from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| fieldsAdd total_tokens = arraySum(total)
| fields total_tokens

3.title: Avg report duration (s)
3.query:
timeseries avg_dur = avg(gen_ai.client.operation.duration),
  filter: { gen_ai.agent.name == "alpha_orchestrator" },
  from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| fieldsAdd avg_seconds = arrayAvg(avg_dur)
| fields avg_seconds

4.title: Error rate
4.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter span.name == "invoke_agent alpha_orchestrator"
| summarize
    total  = count(),
    errors = countIf(gen_ai.response.finish_reasons == "[\"error\"]")
| fieldsAdd error_rate_pct = if(total > 0, 100 * errors / total, else: 0)
| fields error_rate_pct

6.title: Token usage over time — by agent
6.query:
timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage),
  by: { gen_ai.agent.name },
  from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to

7.title: Token usage — input vs output
7.query:
timeseries tokens = sum(gen_ai.client.token.usage),
  by: { gen_ai.token.type },
  from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to

8.title: Tokens by model
8.query:
fetch metric.series, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter metric.key == "gen_ai.client.token.usage_sum"
| summarize tokens = sum(arraySum(value)), by: { gen_ai.request.model }
| sort tokens desc

9.title: Top 10 agents by token consumption
9.query:
fetch metric.series, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter metric.key == "gen_ai.client.token.usage_sum"
| summarize
    input_tokens  = sum(arraySum(value), default:0) filter: { gen_ai.token.type == "input"  },
    output_tokens = sum(arraySum(value), default:0) filter: { gen_ai.token.type == "output" },
    by: { gen_ai.agent.name }
| fieldsAdd total = input_tokens + output_tokens
| sort total desc
| limit 10

11.title: LLM operation duration — p50 / p95 / p99
11.query:
timeseries
  p50 = percentile(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 50),
  p95 = percentile(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 95),
  p99 = percentile(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 99),
  from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to

12.title: p95 latency per agent (s)
12.query:
timeseries p95 = percentile(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 95),
  by: { gen_ai.agent.name },
  from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to

13.title: Agent span duration distribution (heatmap)
13.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter startsWith(span.name, "invoke_agent")
| fieldsAdd duration_s = toDouble(duration) / 1000000000
| summarize count = count(),
    by: { gen_ai.agent.name, bucket = bin(duration_s, 1) }
| sort gen_ai.agent.name asc, bucket asc

15.title: Orchestrator finish reasons
15.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter span.name == "invoke_agent alpha_orchestrator"
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.response.finish_reasons)
| summarize count = count(), by: { finish_reason = gen_ai.response.finish_reasons }

16.title: Tool call mix
16.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter startsWith(span.name, "execute_tool")
| summarize calls = count(), by: { gen_ai.tool.name }
| sort calls desc

17.title: Spans per report (top traces)
17.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter service.name == "alpha-engine"
| summarize span_count = count(), start = takeMin(start_time), end = takeMax(end_time), by: { trace.id }
| fieldsAdd duration_s = (toLong(end) - toLong(start)) / 1000000000
| sort start desc
| limit 25
| fields trace.id, start, duration_s, span_count

19.title: Recent reports
19.query:
fetch spans, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter span.name == "invoke_agent alpha_orchestrator"
| sort start_time desc
| limit 25
| fields
    start_time,
    duration,
    gen_ai.agent.id,
    gen_ai.usage.input_tokens,
    gen_ai.usage.output_tokens,
    gen_ai.response.finish_reasons,
    trace.id

21.title: Recent task-runner events
21.query:
fetch events, from: $timeframe.from, to: $timeframe.to
| filter event.kind == "CUSTOM_INFO" or event.kind == "CUSTOM_DEPLOYMENT"
| filter contains(event.name, "alpha") or contains(event.title, "alpha") or contains(event.source, "tasks.")
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 25
| fields timestamp, event.kind, event.name, event.status, event.duration_ms, event.source
